<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>HellHounds - Women Flag Football Team 2027</title>
<style>
:root{--red:#E10613;--dark-red:#9c0410;--black:#0d0d0d;--ink:#222;--fill:#FFF3F3;--line:#d6d6d6;--teal:#E10613;--navy:#111;--head:Impact,Haettenschweiler,"Arial Narrow Bold","Arial Black",sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;padding:calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 14px calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);
 background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%,#5a0208 0,#160204 40%,#0a0a0a 75%) fixed}
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #000,0 10px 50px rgba(225,6,19,.35);
 background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.94),rgba(255,255,255,.94)),url(data:image/webp;base64,) no-repeat center 420px/560px,#fff}
.body{padding:8px 22px 26px}
header.hero{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:22px 26px 30px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#000 0,#111 55%,var(--red) 55.2%,var(--dark-red) 100%);}
header.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:8px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--red) 0 14px,#000 14px 28px)}
.logo{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover;border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--red),0 6px 18px #000a;flex:none}
.hero h1{margin:0;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:normal;font-size:clamp(24px,4.4vw,46px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--red)}
.hero h1 span{color:#fff;display:block;font-size:.5em;letter-spacing:5px;margin-top:8px;text-shadow:none;color:#ff9aa0}
.tag{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;background:#fff;color:#000;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;padding:4px 14px;transform:skew(-12deg);border-left:6px solid var(--red)}
h2{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:normal;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:18px;color:#fff;background:#0d0d0d;border-left:12px solid var(--red);padding:9px 18px;margin:26px 0 12px;text-align:left;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 18px) 100%,0 100%)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px}
.span2{grid-column:span 2}.full{grid-column:1/-1}
label{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;background:#111;border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:5px 9px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0}
.f input,.f textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;background:var(--fill);padding:8px;font:inherit;border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;transition:.15s}
.f input:focus,.f textarea:focus,td input:focus,td textarea:focus,.ab input:focus{outline:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--red);background:#fff}
.f textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:40px}
.f input[type=checkbox]{width:18px;height:18px;padding:0;flex:none;accent-color:var(--red)}
.cl{border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;background:var(--fill);padding:8px 10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:2px 14px;border-radius:0 0 6px 6px}
.f .cl label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:none;border:0;color:#222;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:14px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}
.f .cl label:hover{background:#ffe1e3}
input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--red)}
.cl.ab{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.cl.tg{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px 14px;padding:12px}
.tg b{display:block;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:normal;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red);margin-bottom:3px;font-size:15px}
.tg .mg b{color:#000}
.tg textarea{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;min-height:70px}
.ab .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:190px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:3px 0}
.ab .row b{color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.ab .row input{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:6px}
.ab .none{color:#666;font-style:italic}
@media(max-width:600px){.ab .row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tw{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:1200px;background:#fff}
th{background:#0d0d0d;color:#fff;padding:9px 6px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #000;border-bottom:3px solid var(--red)}
td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:2px}
tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#fafafa}
tbody tr:hover{background:#fff0f1}
td input,td textarea{width:100%;border:0;background:var(--fill);padding:6px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;border-radius:4px}
td textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:44px}
td.c{text-align:center;background:#111;color:#fff;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;padding:4px 6px;font-size:12px}
td.c.st{background:#f1f1f1;color:#111}td.c.en{background:#f1f1f1;color:var(--red)}
tr.ex td:first-child{background:var(--red)}
tr.ex td input,tr.ex td textarea{font-style:italic}
.tot{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;font-weight:700;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pill{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:#eee;font-weight:800}
.ok{background:#111;color:#fff}.bad{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
#sum{background:#111;color:#fff;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:normal;letter-spacing:1px}
button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--red),var(--dark-red));color:#fff;border:0;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;margin:4px 6px 0 0;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #5f020a;transition:.12s}
button:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);filter:brightness(1.1)}button:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #5f020a}
button.sec{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#333,#000);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #000}
td button.sec{padding:4px 9px;margin:0;box-shadow:none}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
@media(max-width:800px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.span2{grid-column:span 1}header.hero{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(#000,#1a0104)}}
.chk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:-1px;background:#fff}
.chk:hover{background:var(--fill)}
.chk label{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border:0}
.chk input[type=checkbox]{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.note{font-size:12px;color:#666;font-style:italic}
#rev label{margin-top:6px}
@media print{body{background:#fff!important;padding:0;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}.wrap{box-shadow:none;border-radius:0}.noprint{display:none}@page{size:landscape;margin:10mm}}
.stat{display:inline-block;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;background:#555;color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px}.stat.live{background:#111}.stat.live:before{content:'\25CF ';color:#3ddc84}.stat.off{background:var(--red)}
td select{width:100%;border:0;background:var(--fill);padding:6px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;border-radius:4px;min-width:120px}
td select:focus{outline:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--red);background:#fff}
.ms{min-width:150px}
.ms summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--fill);border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;min-height:30px;white-space:normal}
.ms summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.ms summary:after{content:" \25BE";color:var(--red);float:right}
.ms details[open] summary{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--red);background:#fff}
.ms .pn{position:fixed;z-index:50;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--red);border-radius:8px;padding:6px;min-width:230px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0006}
.ms .pn label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:none;color:#222;border:0;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer}
.ms .pn label:hover{background:#ffe1e3}
.ms .pn input{width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:var(--red)}
table th:nth-child(6),table td:nth-child(6){min-width:230px}
tr[data-f=water] td:not(.c),tr[data-f=water] td.st,tr[data-f=water] td.en,tr[data-f=water] td input,tr[data-f=water] td textarea,tr[data-f=water] .ms summary{background:#BFE0FF}
tr[data-f=grey] td:not(.c),tr[data-f=grey] td.st,tr[data-f=grey] td.en,tr[data-f=grey] td input,tr[data-f=grey] td textarea,tr[data-f=grey] .ms summary{background:#D3D3D3}
tr[data-f=green] td:not(.c),tr[data-f=green] td.st,tr[data-f=green] td.en,tr[data-f=green] td input,tr[data-f=green] td textarea,tr[data-f=green] .ms summary{background:#BDE8C1}
tr[data-f=white] td:not(.c),tr[data-f=white] td.st,tr[data-f=white] td.en,tr[data-f=white] td input,tr[data-f=white] td textarea,tr[data-f=white] .ms summary{background:#FFFFFF}
table th:nth-child(4),table td:nth-child(4){min-width:84px;width:84px}
input[data-k=min]{-moz-appearance:textfield;appearance:textfield;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
input[data-k=min]::-webkit-outer-spin-button,input[data-k=min]::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=hidden]),textarea{text-align:center}
td{vertical-align:middle}
textarea{resize:none!important}
.ms summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px}
.ms summary:after{float:none;flex:none;margin:0}
.ms .pn{max-height:min(60vh,420px);overflow-y:auto}
input[type=date],input[type=time]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;display:block;min-width:0;max-width:100%;min-height:40px}
@media(max-width:720px){
.tw{box-shadow:none;overflow:visible;border-radius:0}
table{min-width:0!important;background:transparent}
thead{display:none}
table,tbody,tr,td{display:block;width:100%}
tbody tr{border:2px solid #111;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
td,table td{border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid #eee!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 10px!important;min-width:0!important;width:100%!important}
td::before{flex:0 0 100px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#777;text-align:left}
td>input,td>textarea,td>details{flex:1;min-width:0;width:auto}
td.c{justify-content:flex-start}
td:nth-child(1){background:#111!important;color:#fff;font-size:15px}
td:nth-child(1)::before{color:#ff9aa0}
td:nth-child(11){justify-content:flex-end}
.ms .pn{position:fixed}
td:nth-child(1)::before{content:"Drill #"}
td:nth-child(2)::before{content:"Start"}
td:nth-child(3)::before{content:"Drill / Activity"}
td:nth-child(4)::before{content:"Minutes"}
td:nth-child(5)::before{content:"End"}
td:nth-child(6)::before{content:"Focus Area"}
td:nth-child(7)::before{content:"Description"}
td:nth-child(8)::before{content:"Equipment"}
td:nth-child(9)::before{content:"Lead Coach"}
td:nth-child(10)::before{content:"Same time as row above"}
td:nth-child(11)::before{content:""}
}
td.pt{text-align:center}
td.pt input{width:20px!important;height:20px;padding:0;background:none!important;accent-color:var(--red);cursor:pointer}
table th:nth-child(10){min-width:86px}
tr.par td:nth-child(1){box-shadow:inset 7px 0 var(--red)}
tr.par td:nth-child(2),tr.par td:nth-child(5){font-style:italic}
@media(max-width:720px){td.pt input{flex:none}}
</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
<header class="hero"><div class="logo"></div><div><h1>HellHounds<span>Women Flag Football Team 2027</span></h1><div class="tag">DAILY PRACTICE PLAN</div></div></header>
<div class="body">
<noscript><p style="background:#E10613;color:#fff;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700">This viewer has JavaScript turned off, so the lists and drill rows cannot load. Open this page in a normal browser (Safari / Chrome) or use the live link.</p></noscript>

<div id="stat" class="stat noprint">Connecting...</div> <span class="note noprint">Pink boxes = fill in. Every change is shared live with all coaches - no save button needed.</span>

<div class="grid">
<div class="f"><label>Date</label><input type="date" id="date"></div>
<div class="f"><label>Practice #</label><input id="pnum"></div>
<div class="f"><label>Field / Location</label><input id="field"></div>
<div class="f"><label>Start Time</label><input type="time" id="start" value="17:00"></div>
<div class="f"><label>Total Time (min)</label><input type="number" id="total" value="90" min="1"></div>
<div class="f full"><label>Coaches (tick who is attending)</label><div class="cl" id="coaches"></div></div>
<div class="f full"><label id="presL">Players Present (untick a player who is not attending)</label><div class="cl" id="pres"></div></div>
<div class="f full"><label id="absL">Players Absent</label><div class="cl ab" id="abs"></div></div>
<div class="f full"><label>Theme / Goal of Today's Practice - comments per coach &amp; management</label><div class="cl tg" id="theme"></div></div>
</div>

<h2>PRACTICE SCHEDULE - DRILLS &amp; TIME PER DRILL</h2>
<div class="tw"><table>
<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Start</th><th style="width:16%">Drill / Activity</th><th>Min</th><th>End</th><th>Focus Area</th><th style="width:28%">Description &amp; Coaching Points</th><th>Equipment</th><th>Lead Coach</th><th title="Runs at the same time as the row above">Same time</th><th class="noprint"></th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="rows"></tbody></table></div>
<datalist id="focus"><option>Warm-up<option>Flag pulling / Defense<option>QB drills<option>Catching<option>Route running<option>Snap<option>Offense plays<option>Coverage / Defense scheme<option>Speed &amp; agility<option>Conditioning<option>Scrimmage<option>Water break<option>Cool-down / Team talk<option>Others</datalist>
<div class="tot"><span>Total planned: <span class="pill" id="sum">0</span> min</span><span class="pill" id="chk"></span><span class="note" id="ends"></span>
<button class="noprint" onclick="addRow()">+ Add drill row</button><button class="noprint" onclick="addRow(true)">+ Add drill at the SAME time</button></div>
<p class="note">Tip: add water breaks as their own drill row so the total matches the practice length. Row colours follow Focus Area: blue = water break, grey = defense (flag pulling / coverage), green = QB drills, white = catching / route running / offense plays. Tick "Same time" on a row to run it at the same time as the row above (for example offense, defense and QB groups together); the total counts clock time, not the sum.</p>

<div class="two">
<div><h2>EQUIPMENT CHECKLIST</h2><div id="checks"></div></div>
<div><h2>POST-PRACTICE REVIEW</h2><div class="f" id="rev"></div></div>
</div>

<div class="noprint" style="margin-top:16px">
<button onclick="window.print()">Print / Save as PDF</button>
<button class="sec" onclick="if(confirm('Clear everything and start a new practice plan?')){clearAll()}">New / Clear all</button>
</div>
</div></div>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.10.1/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.10.1/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.10.1/firebase-database-compat.js"></script>
<script>
const coaches=["Mohamed Elwazier","Aly Sokar","Yasmine Elkhayat","Abdelrahman Yasser","Mahmoud Abo Shady"];
const players=["Alia Amr","Alia Ahmed","Farah Ksaybati","Farah Sayed","Hana Amr","Habiba El Aassar","Judy Khalil","Logein Tarek","Mariam Sedik","Mennah Ashraf","Menna Khaled","Noha Khalil","Nadeen Baheir","Rawan Khaled","Reem Serry","Razan","Salma Ibrahim","Sonia Medhat","Menna Yasser","Zainab Farouk"];
const checks=["Flag belts","Footballs","Cones & markers"];
const rev=["What worked well","What to improve","Players to praise / follow up","Focus for next practice"];
const fids=["date","pnum","field","start","total"];
const tgNames=[...coaches,"Management"];
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),tb=$("rows");
const esc=t=>String(t).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;").replace(/</g,"&lt;");
let main=null,rowsCol=null,state={},patch={},canWrite=true,got={m:false,r:false},seeded=false,lastKey=null;
const setDeep=(o,p,v)=>{const k=p.split(".");let c=o;k.slice(0,-1).forEach(x=>c=c[x]=c[x]||{});c[k[k.length-1]]=v};
const getDeep=(o,p)=>p.split(".").reduce((c,x)=>c==null?undefined:c[x],o);
const merge=(a,b)=>{for(const k in b){if(b[k]&&typeof b[k]=="object"){a[k]=a[k]&&typeof a[k]=="object"?a[k]:{};merge(a[k],b[k])}else a[k]=b[k]}return a};
function setStat(t,c){const e=$("stat");e.textContent=t;e.className="stat noprint "+(c||"")}
// ---- static UI
fids.forEach(i=>$(i).dataset.p="f."+i);
$("coaches").innerHTML=coaches.map((n,i)=>`<label><input type="checkbox" checked data-p="cc.${i}"> ${n}</label>`).join("");
$("pres").innerHTML=players.map((n,i)=>`<label><input type="checkbox" checked data-p="pc.${i}"> ${i+1}. ${n}</label>`).join("");
$("theme").innerHTML=tgNames.map((n,i)=>`<div class="${i==coaches.length?"mg":""}"><b>${n}</b><textarea rows="3" data-p="tg.${i}" placeholder="Theme / goal / comment..."></textarea></div>`).join("");
$("checks").innerHTML=checks.map((c,i)=>`<div class="chk"><label style="background:none;color:#222;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;padding:0"><input type="checkbox" data-p="eq.${i}.chk"> ${c}</label><input type="text" data-p="eq.${i}.who" placeholder="Who has it? (name)" style="flex:1;border:1px solid #BFBFBF;background:#FFF3F3;padding:5px;font:inherit;border-radius:4px"></div>`).join("");
$("rev").innerHTML=rev.map((r,i)=>`<label>${r}</label><textarea rows="2" data-p="rev.${i}" style="margin-bottom:6px;width:100%;border:1px solid #BFBFBF;background:#FFF3F3;padding:6px;font:inherit"></textarea>`).join("");
// ---- shared-field sync (merged writes, one at a time)
let ft=null,fq=Promise.resolve();
function bind(e){e.addEventListener(e.type==="checkbox"?"change":"input",()=>{
 const v=e.type==="checkbox"?e.checked:e.value;setDeep(state,e.dataset.p,v);setDeep(patch,e.dataset.p,v);
 if(e.dataset.p.startsWith("pc."))renderAbsent();calc();
 if(!main)return;clearTimeout(ft);ft=setTimeout(()=>{const p=patch;patch={};fq=fq.then(()=>main.update(p)).catch(()=>setStat("Save failed - retrying on next edit","off"))},400)})}
document.querySelectorAll("[data-p]").forEach(bind);
function applyState(){
 document.querySelectorAll("[data-p]").forEach(e=>{const v=getDeep(state,e.dataset.p);if(v===undefined)return;
  if(e.type==="checkbox")e.checked=!!v;else if(e!==document.activeElement&&e.value!==v)e.value=v});
 renderAbsent();calc()}
function renderAbsent(){
 const pc=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pres input")],a=$("abs"),out=[];pc.forEach((e,i)=>{if(!e.checked)out.push(i)});
 $("presL").textContent="Players Present: "+(players.length-out.length)+" of "+players.length+" (untick a player who is not attending)";
 $("absL").textContent="Players Absent: "+out.length+" (added automatically - type the reason)";
 const key=out.join(",");
 if(key!==lastKey){lastKey=key;const ae=document.activeElement,ap=ae&&ae.dataset&&ae.dataset.p;
  a.innerHTML=out.length?out.map(i=>`<div class="row"><b>${esc(players[i])}</b><input data-p="rs.${i}" placeholder="Reason for absence (sick, exam, travel, injury...)" value="${esc(getDeep(state,"rs."+i)||"")}"></div>`).join(""):'<span class="none">Everyone is present.</span>';
  a.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(bind);
  if(ap&&ap.startsWith("rs.")){const n=a.querySelector(`[data-p="${ap}"]`);if(n){n.focus();n.setSelectionRange(n.value.length,n.value.length)}}
 }else a.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(e=>{const v=getDeep(state,e.dataset.p)||"";if(e!==document.activeElement&&e.value!==v)e.value=v});
 if(!canWrite)lockUI()}
// ---- drill rows (one document per row)
const fmt=m=>{m=((m%1440)+1440)%1440;let h=Math.floor(m/60),mm=m%60,ap=h>=12?"PM":"AM";h=h%12||12;return h+":"+String(mm).padStart(2,"0")+" "+ap};
const FK={"water break":"water","flag pulling / defense":"grey","coverage / defense scheme":"grey","qb drills":"green","catching":"white","route running":"white","offense plays":"white"};
const fk=v=>FK[String(v||"").split(",")[0].trim().toLowerCase().replace("defence","defense")]||"";
function calc(){fitAll();
 const g=id=>document.getElementById(id),s=g("start").value||"00:00",t0=+s.slice(0,2)*60+ +s.slice(3);
 let gS=t0,gE=t0,sum=0;const grp=[],rows=[...tb.rows];
 rows.forEach((r,i)=>{r.dataset.f=fk(r.querySelector('[data-k="focus"]').value);
  const d=+r.querySelector('[data-k="min"]').value||0,par=i>0&&r.querySelector('[data-k="par"]').checked;
  if(!par){gS=gE;grp.push([])}
  r.classList.toggle("par",par);
  r.querySelector(".st").textContent=fmt(gS);r.querySelector(".en").textContent=d?fmt(gS+d):"";
  if(d)gE=Math.max(gE,gS+d);sum+=d;grp[grp.length-1].push(r)});
 const off=rows[0]&&rows[0].classList.contains("ex")?0:1;
 grp.forEach((rs,k)=>rs.forEach((r,j)=>{if(r.classList.contains("ex"))return;const b=k+off===0?"EX":k+off;r.cells[0].textContent=rs.length>1?b+String.fromCharCode(97+j):b}));
 const span=gE-t0,tot=+g("total").value||0,c=g("chk");
 g("sum").textContent=span;
 g("ends").textContent="Ends at "+fmt(gE)+(sum!==span?"  |  drill minutes added together: "+sum:"");
 c.className="pill "+(span===tot?"ok":"bad");
 c.textContent=span===tot?"OK - matches practice length":span>tot?"OVER by "+(span-tot)+" min":"Short "+(tot-span)+" min"}
const rp={};let rq=Promise.resolve();
const focusOpts=["Warm-up","Water break","Flag pulling / Defense","QB drills","Catching","Route running","Snap","Offense plays","Coverage / Defense scheme","Speed & agility","Conditioning","Scrimmage","Cool-down / Team talk","Others"];
function fitAll(){document.querySelectorAll("textarea").forEach(t=>{t.rows=1;t.style.height="auto";t.style.padding="8px";
 const m=Math.max(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(t).minHeight)||0,44),c=Math.max(t.scrollHeight-16,18),H=Math.max(m,c+16);
 t.style.padding=((H-c)/2)+"px 8px";t.style.height=H+"px"})}
window.addEventListener("resize",fitAll);window.addEventListener("load",fitAll);
function msInit(td){const h=td.querySelector("input[type=hidden]"),sm=td.querySelector("summary"),bx=[...td.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]")];
 const sync=()=>{const sel=h.value?h.value.split(", "):[];bx.forEach(b=>b.checked=sel.includes(b.value));sm.textContent=sel.length?sel.join(", "):(td.dataset.ph||"Select")};
 bx.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("change",()=>{h.value=bx.filter(x=>x.checked).map(x=>x.value).join(", ");sync();h.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}))}));
 td._sync=sync;sync()}
document.addEventListener("toggle",e=>{const d=e.target;if(!d.matches||!d.matches(".ms details")||!d.open)return;
 document.querySelectorAll(".ms details[open]").forEach(o=>{if(o!==d)o.open=false});
 window.__msY=scrollY;const pn=d.querySelector(".pn"),r=d.querySelector("summary").getBoundingClientRect(),h=pn.offsetHeight;
 pn.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(r.left,innerWidth-pn.offsetWidth-8))+"px";pn.style.top=(r.bottom+h>innerHeight?Math.max(8,r.top-h):r.bottom)+"px"},true);
document.addEventListener("click",e=>document.querySelectorAll(".ms details[open]").forEach(d=>{if(!d.contains(e.target))d.open=false}));
document.addEventListener("click",()=>window.__msT=Date.now(),true);
window.addEventListener("scroll",e=>{if(e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".pn"))return;if(Date.now()-(window.__msT||0)<400)return;document.querySelectorAll(".ms details[open]").forEach(d=>d.open=false)},true);
function makeRow(id){const tr=document.createElement("tr");tr.dataset.id=id;
 tr.innerHTML=`<td class="c num"></td><td class="c st"></td><td><input data-k="drill"></td><td><input data-k="min" type="number" min="0" style="text-align:center"></td><td class="c en"></td>
 <td class="ms" data-ph="Select focus area(s)"><input type="hidden" data-k="focus"><details><summary>Select focus area(s)</summary><div class="pn">${focusOpts.map(c=>`<label><input type="checkbox" value="${c}"> ${c}</label>`).join("")}</div></details></td><td><textarea data-k="desc"></textarea></td><td><input data-k="equip"></td><td class="ms" data-ph="Select coach(es)"><input type="hidden" data-k="lead"><details><summary>Select coach(es)</summary><div class="pn">${coaches.map(c=>`<label><input type="checkbox" value="${c}"> ${c}</label>`).join("")}</div></details></td>
 <td class="pt"><input type="checkbox" data-k="par" title="Runs at the same time as the row above"></td>
 <td class="noprint"><button class="sec" title="Remove" data-del>x</button></td>`;
 tr.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(e=>e.addEventListener("input",()=>{calc();if(!rowsCol)return;
  (rp[id]=rp[id]||{})[e.dataset.k]=e.type==="checkbox"?e.checked:e.value;clearTimeout(rp[id+"t"]);
  rp[id+"t"]=setTimeout(()=>{const p=rp[id];rp[id]={};rq=rq.then(()=>rowsCol.doc(id).update(p)).catch(()=>{})},400)}));
 tr.querySelectorAll(".ms").forEach(msInit);
 tr.querySelector("[data-del]").onclick=()=>{if(rowsCol)rowsCol.doc(id).delete().catch(()=>{});else{tr.remove();calc()}};
 return tr}
function renderRows(docs){
 docs.sort((a,b)=>(a.n||0)-(b.n||0));const keep=new Set(docs.map(d=>d.id));
 [...tb.rows].forEach(r=>{if(!keep.has(r.dataset.id))r.remove()});let k=0;
 docs.forEach((d,i)=>{let tr=tb.querySelector(`tr[data-id="${d.id}"]`)||makeRow(d.id);
  if(tb.rows[i]!==tr)tb.insertBefore(tr,tb.rows[i]||null);
  tr.className=d.ex?"ex":"";tr.querySelector(".num").textContent=d.ex?"EX":++k;
  tr.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(e=>{const v=d[e.dataset.k]??"";if(e.type==="checkbox"){e.checked=!!v;return}if(e!==document.activeElement&&e.value!==String(v))e.value=v});tr.querySelectorAll(".ms").forEach(t=>t._sync())});
 calc();if(!canWrite)lockUI()}
const exRow={ex:true,drill:"Flag Pulling Relay",min:10,focus:"Flag pulling / Defense",desc:"Two lines, ball carrier vs defender. Break down, eyes on hips, pull both flags.",equip:"Flags, cones",lead:coaches[0]};
const blank=n=>({n,drill:"",min:"",focus:"",desc:"",equip:"",lead:""});
async function seed(){if(seeded)return;seeded=true;
 if(!main)return;
 for(let i=1;i<=10;i++)await rowsCol.doc("r"+String(i).padStart(4,"0")).set(i==1?{n:1,...exRow}:blank(i));
 await main.set({v:1,seeded:true,...state})}
function addRow(par){if(!rowsCol){const tr=makeRow("l"+Date.now());tb.appendChild(tr);if(par)tr.querySelector('[data-k="par"]').checked=true;calc();return}
 const n=Math.max(0,...[...tb.rows].map(r=>+r.dataset.n||0))+1;
 rowsCol.doc("r"+Date.now().toString(36)).set({...blank(Object.keys(rowN).length?Math.max(...Object.values(rowN))+1:1),par:!!par})}
let rowN={};
async function clearAll(){if(!main){location.reload();return}
 for(const r of [...tb.rows])await rowsCol.doc(r.dataset.id).delete().catch(()=>{});
 state={};patch={};seeded=false;await main.set({v:1});
 document.querySelectorAll("[data-p]").forEach(e=>{if(e.type==="checkbox")e.checked=e.dataset.p.startsWith("cc.")||e.dataset.p.startsWith("pc.");else e.value=""});
 lastKey=null;applyState();await seed()}
function lockUI(){document.querySelectorAll("input,textarea,button:not([onclick*=print])").forEach(e=>e.disabled=true)}
// ---- online shared connection (Firebase Realtime Database)
// 1) Create a Firebase project.
// 2) Enable Authentication -> Sign-in method -> Anonymous.
// 3) Create Realtime Database.
// 4) Replace the values below with your Firebase Web App config.
const FIREBASE_CONFIG = {
  apiKey: "PASTE_YOUR_FIREBASE_API_KEY",
  authDomain: "PASTE_YOUR_PROJECT_ID.firebaseapp.com",
  databaseURL: "https://PASTE_YOUR_DATABASE_NAME-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com",
  projectId: "PASTE_YOUR_PROJECT_ID",
  storageBucket: "PASTE_YOUR_PROJECT_ID.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "PASTE_YOUR_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID",
  appId: "PASTE_YOUR_APP_ID"
};
function firebaseConfigReady(){
  return FIREBASE_CONFIG.apiKey && !FIREBASE_CONFIG.apiKey.startsWith("PASTE_") &&
         FIREBASE_CONFIG.projectId && !FIREBASE_CONFIG.projectId.startsWith("PASTE_") &&
         FIREBASE_CONFIG.databaseURL && !FIREBASE_CONFIG.databaseURL.includes("PASTE_YOUR");
}
(async()=>{
  if(!firebaseConfigReady()){
    setStat("Setup required - add Firebase config to enable live sharing","off");
    renderAbsent(); addRow0(); return;
  }
  try{
    if(!firebase.apps.length) firebase.initializeApp(FIREBASE_CONFIG);
    await firebase.auth().signInAnonymously();
    const db=firebase.database();
    const mainRef=db.ref("practice/main");
    const rowsRef=db.ref("practice/rows");
    main=db; rowsCol={
      doc:id=>({
        update:p=>db.ref("practice/rows/"+id).update(p),
        delete:()=>db.ref("practice/rows/"+id).remove(),
        set:p=>db.ref("practice/rows/"+id).set(p)
      })
    };
const ready=()=>{
      if(got.m&&got.r){
        if(!state.seeded&&!tb.rows.length&&canWrite)seed();
        else seeded=true;
        if(canWrite)setStat("Live - synced with all coaches","live");
      }
    };
mainRef.on("value",snap=>{
      const d=snap.exists()?snap.val():{};
      state=merge(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d)),patch);
      got.m=true; applyState(); ready();
    },()=>setStat("Disconnected - check Firebase connection","off"));
rowsRef.on("value",snap=>{
      const docs=[]; rowN={};
      snap.forEach(child=>{
        const d={id:child.key,...(child.val()||{})};
        docs.push(d); rowN[d.id]=d.n||0;
      });
      got.r=true; renderRows(docs); ready();
    },()=>setStat("Disconnected - check Firebase connection","off"));
// Replace the existing main document update calls with Firebase updates.
    main={
      update:p=>mainRef.update(p),
      set:p=>mainRef.set(p)
    };
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e);
    setStat("Connection failed - check Firebase setup","off");
    renderAbsent(); addRow0();
  }
})();
function addRow0(){for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const t=makeRow("l"+i);tb.appendChild(t);if(!i){t.className="ex";t.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(e=>e.value=exRow[e.dataset.k]??"")}}[...tb.rows].forEach((r,i)=>r.querySelector(".num").textContent=i?i:"EX");calc()}
renderAbsent();calc();
</script></body></html>
